load_config: load the Hermes agent configuration from ~/.hermes/config.yaml with default merging and environment variable expansion
save_config: save a configuration dictionary to ~/.hermes/config.yaml preserving env var templates and secure permissions
validate_config_structure: validate the Hermes config.yaml structure and return a list of detected issues with severity and fix hints
migrate_config: migrate Hermes config to the latest version and prompt for any missing required environment variables
set_config_value: set a configuration value in config.yaml or .env depending on whether the key is an API key or a config path
